Notice Of Motion To Terminate Restraining Order
Off Calendar Oct-26-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: All parties and witnesses were sworn prior to the commencement of the proceedings.

Appearances: Chris Morales for and with Ada Morales (Petitioner).

The Court stated that this motion is not support by any memorandum of points and authorities or a declaration. Counsel stated the Petitioner wants to terminate the Restraining Order because she does not have any problems with the Respondent (Granddaughter) and that the Respondent does not want to have the Restraining Order on her record. The Petitioner stated that she has no contact with her granddaughter and that she is not being pressure to bring this motion. The Court granted the Motion to Terminate Restraining Order (subject to receipt of the order). The Court instructed counsel to include the date of the Restrating Order in the order and the Petitioner is responsible to provide copy of the order to the proper authority.

Judge: Peter J. Busch. Court Reporter: LaVena Ward, CSR #7077 . Clerk: Ella Yip. Bailiff: Deputy M. Benton.

NOTICE OF HEARING AND TEMPORARY RESTRAINING ORDER (ELDER OR DEPENDENT ADULT ABUSE)
Off Calendar Feb-23-2011 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on calendar today for Elder Adult Abuse OSC and TRO hearing this day.

Dept. 204. Judge Pro Tem: Sue Kaplan. Court Reporter: S. Hughes, CSR# 12365. Clerk: Rosie Noguera. Bailiff: Deputy A. Payne.

Petitioner: Ada Morales was present.

Respondent: Janelle McGovern was present.

The Court hears testimony, receives evidence and after hearing the evidence presented, the Petitioner's order is Granted as follows: Respondent shall stay at least 100 yards away from the protected person: Ada Morales, her Residence and place of business if any. Respondent must immediately move out from and not return to 2766 California Street, San Francisco, CA 94115

Respondent shall not Physically Abuse, Financially Abuse, Intimidate, Molest, Attack, Assault (sexually or otherwise), Hit, Follow, Stalk, Threaten, Harass, Destroy Personal Property, Keep under Surveillance, or Block Movements, Contact (directly or indirectly), Telephone, Send Messages, Mail or e-Mail, Take Any Action, Directly or Through Others, to
Obtain the Addresses or Locations of the Protected Persons.

No Guns or Other Firearms.

Expires: February 23, 2014.

Order signed.
